summary: Two listings date the Vavenby Mountain lookout to 1956 at 1,866 m; no source found describes the site, its staffing, its fate or its state today.

events.note: Firelookout.ca gives 'Built in 1956'; Canada Lookouts gives '1956: The lookout constructed.'

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The brief's status 'standing' and kind 'tower' are not supported by any page read: Firelookout.ca shows Tower Type and Structure Height as N/A and gives no status, so neither is in facts. The 1866 m elevation has no facts key in the schema, so it appears only in the story. The Rainlander list entry 'Vavenby Mountain Lookout (Vavenby)' sits in a list whose context was not clear; it is used only as a name variant, and the trail guide's 'fewer than a hundred' line is province-wide context, not a claim about this site. Facebook group posts about Vavenby returned a login wall. AllTrails returned HTTP 403. The Canada Lookouts page is a long index; only the Avery entry was used. A search snippet mentioned a cell-tower access road; it was not read in full and is not in the story. Fate and staffing are not supported by any source read.
